definitions.explanation: Of threads, cords, branches or limbs: to wind around one another so that they are tangled together.

definitions.gloss: to be intertwined; to be intricately connected
definitions.explanation: Of factors, interests, feelings or plot lines: to be bound up with one another so that they cannot be separated.
